latency_measurement.protocol: One sequential local run after warming mxbai-embed-large in Ollama.
latency_measurement.included_work: Query embedding, database retrieval, rank fusion, and reranking when applicable.
latency_measurement.scope_note: These values describe one local development machine and are not a production load test. Repeated runs are required before making latency guarantees.

configuration.corpus_scope: Only the five versioned documents under docs/demo-data.

reranker.structured_identifier_rule: A query token must contain a digit and one of . _ : -

interpretation.top_1_result: Identifier-gated hybrid reranking returned a relevant first result for 41 of 50 questions, compared with 31 for semantic, 39 for lexical, and 36 for the original hybrid strategy.
interpretation.top_3_result: Hybrid and hybrid-reranked retrieval both reached 0.980 mean recall at three, showing that reranking improved ordering without reducing the underlying top-three candidate coverage.
interpretation.latency_tradeoff: Lexical retrieval was dramatically faster because it skipped query embedding. At the application's default limit of three, hybrid and hybrid-reranked had identical quality, while the single measured reranked run had higher mean, p50, and p95 latency.
interpretation.cost_tradeoff: Lexical retrieval used no embedding input tokens. Semantic, hybrid, and hybrid-reranked retrieval each used 846 local embedding input tokens. These are a compute-usage proxy, not a billed monetary cost, because the benchmark used local Ollama.
interpretation.provisional_production_candidate: Hybrid retrieval is the next production integration experiment because the application supplies three chunks to the answer model: hybrid improved recall at three from 0.880 to 0.980 over semantic retrieval, while reranking did not further improve the top-three set in this benchmark.
interpretation.scope_note: This controlled synthetic benchmark is stronger evidence than the earlier 12-case experiment but does not prove production performance on unseen organizations or document collections.
interpretation.next_step: Integrate hybrid retrieval behind the RAG service, preserve the API source contract, and rerun answer evaluation before accepting it as the production default.
